verdict.rationale: Temporal is a durable execution platform with a Web UI and CLI, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. However, the AI evidence only covers developer building blocks for constructing your own agents: running agent loops as Workflows, the OpenAI Agents SDK integration, and LLM cookbooks. Nothing shows an assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
